title: ERP contribution to subsequent social choice

titles: Reward and emotion prediction-error social-learning EEG

scientific_question: Do measured ERP amplitudes improve next-choice prediction beyond partner, outcome and affect history?
primary_outputs: Probability of the next recorded choice, linked within participant and block.

trial_tables.semantic_scope: 7380 individual trials from 41 participants, not plotted group estimates. Behavioral and ERP tables contain matching row counts; official source binds columns by retained row order.

continuous_recordings.license: MIT, explicitly identified by OSF project license API

archive.note: Concept DOI 15739721 resolves to this code/processed-table archive; continuous EEG is separately hosted on OSF.

recording_contract.neural: 7380 actual trial-level ERP amplitude measurements from41 people, plus41 public .set/.fdt cleaned continuous EEG pairs. Initial source-supported task starts at measured ERP amplitudes, not raw-signal preprocessing.
recording_contract.labels: Behavior table provides sub,trialGlobal,trialLocal,block,partnerID,choice,RT,experienced/expected reward,valence/arousal; central errors can be recalculated.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Official analysis binds ERP tables by original row order to behavior. Maintain hashes and construct checked sub/trialGlobal IDs before any reorder. Continuous-event-to-ERP extraction is not yet closed.
recording_contract.biological_ids: 41 distinct sub IDs and41 EEG file pairs; repeated trials/partners are nested observations.
recording_contract.evidence: Actual small CSV headers, row counts and subject IDs checked; continuous archive manifest supplies sizes/digests; official R source consumes matching CSVs.

case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: Outer held-out participants; preserve partner/block chronology and all next-trial transitions; never randomly split adjacent history examples.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

controls: Do not expose later choice or outcome

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Participant-macro log loss improvement over a behavioral-history model.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.
